name: ui-surfaces
title: Every multiplayer UI surface at 640x360, 960x540 and 1280x720: lobby, host options, kick/ban, chat, F6, visibility, Repair, pause Match Options

checklist.what: the multiplayer landing: name prompt, Host, Join, Resume, Replays, all inside the panel at this resolution
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_substate Landing, assert_label LabelMultiplayerNamePrompt

checklist.what: host setup with the activity, scene and mode pickers, the port and the player count, no text clipped
each of the six host options pages (Seats, Rules, Network, Recovery, Files, Session) drawn whole, rows above the Back button
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_visible CollectionBoxHostPage<page> 1 and dump_host_options per page

checklist.what: the host's own seat dialog shows Kick and Ban disabled with the reason spelled out
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_enabled ButtonHostSeatDlgKick 0 and the action hint

checklist.what: a seated client's dialog offers Kick and Ban enabled
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_enabled ButtonHostSeatDlgKick 1 and ButtonHostSeatDlgBan 1

checklist.what: the visibility selector drops open and steps LAN only, Unlisted, Listed with the drop inside the panel
checklist.assert: menu script: combo_drop then combo_select with assert_label after each

checklist.what: a Listed session is published to the session directory and shows in the listing
checklist.blocked_by: no live session directory on this machine: the run seeds SessionDirectoryUrl so the Internet page shows its real values, but nothing serves it. The lead runs -net-directory-list against a served directory for this item.

checklist.what: the lobby: both seats named, the activity and mode line, the status line, all fitting at this resolution
checklist.assert: menu script: dump_lobby on both peers

checklist.what: a chat line sent from each peer appears on both peers' lobby chat
checklist.assert: menu script: chat on the host, then chat on the client, with dump_lobby after each

checklist.what: the client's MATCH DETAILS is read-only and its seat dialog offers no moderation
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle M A T C H   D E T A I L S, assert_enabled ButtonHostSeatDlgKick 0

checklist.what: F6 opens the in-match network overlay and closes again; the panel is inside the viewport
checklist.assert: probe: wait panel_open true then false

checklist.what: the overlay's Options view reads the live match rules and its text fits its row
the pause Match Options dialog: title, rules text, repair hint and Close all inside the box
the in-match settings pages are reachable and drawn at this resolution
Resume returns to the match with the overlay and dialogs gone
